subject.title: [Bug]: Empty assistant delivery (footer-only, "— out" usage) on first turn after /new on Telegram-routed topic lane — 2026.5.27

question: For `/new` and `/reset`, should OpenClaw make session rotation transactional by creating the new transcript before publishing the mapping, or publish first and repair/remap missing transcript bindings afterward?
rationale: The remaining bug is real in source, but the durable storage contract and recovery path affect session state, doctor repair, and existing phantom bindings, so automation should not choose the product semantics alone.

options.title: Transactional rotation
options.body: Create and verify the new transcript header before committing the new session mapping, then add a narrow repair path for already-published phantom bindings.

options.title: Repair after publication
options.body: Keep the current publish order but add recovery that detects missing transcript files and remaps or recreates them before user-visible delivery.

options.title: Split the tracker
options.body: Keep this issue as the user-facing tracker while filing narrower repair issues for reset durability, empty compaction, and provider completion symptoms.

recommendation.title: Transactional rotation
recommendation.body: Create and verify the new transcript header before committing the new session mapping, then add a narrow repair path for already-published phantom bindings.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision sits closest to the session lifecycle seam and accessor work in recent history.
